steps: Identify the concept: absolute refractory period during an action potential.
During this period, no stimulus, regardless of strength, can trigger a new action potential.
This inability is due to the voltage-gated Na+ channels being in an inactivated state.
The channels must transition from inactivated to closed (resting) state before they can be activated again.
Therefore, the primary cause is the inactivation of voltage-gated Na+ channels.
